fact: In the 2021-2022 school statistics campaign, primary-school data were collected on paper questionnaires distributed to school directors and keyed online on the STATMENET 2.0 platform in the IEPP (inspectorates), 13 December 2021 to 31 January 2022.
title: Statistiques scolaires de poche 2021-2022
publisher: MENA / DESPS (Ministère de l'Éducation nationale et de l'Alphabétisation)
